heading: Tuesday, August 26, 2025
topLine: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, known as Nano Banana.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, known as Nano Banana
items.summary: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image is an image generation and editing model focused on keeping characters consistent, blending multiple images and making edits from natural-language prompts. Google cited the LMArena leaderboard to call it top-rated for image editing. It launched in the Gemini app and in preview in the Gemini API and Vertex AI.
